name: Desert kit
body:
Source Heroes of the Wild pg. 9
Price 30 gp; Weight 20 lbs.
Category Kits
Description
This kit contains tools necessary for staying cool and hydrated in hot, dry terrain. It includes a 10-foot-by-10-foot piece of canvas, 3 doses of blain bane (see above), a hot weather outfitAPG, a signal whistle, a scarf, and four waterskins.
